question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A turning point

options.text: The time when people decide to give up plans
A change of destiny that is surprising
A decision to turn things around
The time at which an important change starts

solution:
The correct answer is- 'The time at which an important change starts'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'A turning point****​​'** is **'The time at which an important change starts'**
 
• Let’s look at the meaning and example of the given phrasal verb:
 
 
• A turning point- "the time at which a situation starts to change in an important way" (जिस समय एक महत्वपूर्ण तरीके से स्थिति बदलने लगती है)
 
 
• *E.g. *The organization called the new regulations a** turning point i**n the campaign against smoking.

 
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​ * Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 4th option is the correct choice.
